newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed Martin chairman to step down - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin chairman to step down - WSJ.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp Chairman Norman Augustine, 61, has told the company's board he plans to step down as chairman by the end of the year, the Wall Street Journal said in Friday's electronic edition.
According to people familiar with the matter, the job of chief executive officer would go to Vance Coffman, Lockheed's president, the newspaper said.
But the newspaper said one person familiar with Augustine's decision believed the move could be announced within the next week, before the April 24 annual meeting.
The company was not immediately available to comment. A Lockheed spokesman was quoted in the Journal as saying he was not familiar with such a decision.

A person familiar with the development was quoted as saying Augustine told the board he was preparing to pursue "a longstanding personal plan to do other things," the paper said. He would apparently not assume a new senior job at another company or a government post, the paper said.
